build_chroma_pipeline: build a ChromaPipeline for text-to-image generation using T5 text encoder and ChromaTransformer2DModel
run_chroma_text_to_image: run the ChromaPipeline with a prompt and negative prompt to generate an image
create_t5_prompt_embeds: create T5 prompt embeddings with attention masks for the Chroma transformer forward pass
encode_prompt_with_cfg: encode prompt and negative prompt embeddings with classifier-free guidance support
prepare_latents_for_chroma: prepare packed latent tensors and latent image IDs for the Chroma denoising loop
